prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Input image 1 is the paper-object/style reference ONLY; replace reference geography completely with this city.
Tactile mid-century travel-poster screen print: flat layered shapes, fine risograph grain, soft paper fibres, calm elegant Travary navy/teal/coral/sage/mustard/cream family, never photographic. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, decorative script, inscriptions, signs, logos, watermarks, flags, faces or copyrighted characters. All vehicle panels/plates, boat hulls, tram windows and shopfronts blank and unmarked. NO FLAGS OR FLAGPOLES, including tiny bridge-top pennants, roof flags, boat flags or decorative banners. Bridge arches have clean uninterrupted bare tops. Small people may only be featureless silhouettes; prefer empty streets. Exclude theme parks, Hollywood sign, Space Needle, Cloud Gate and casino buildings. Replace ALL American scenery in the template unless this is San Francisco. Famous buildings belong within a balanced city view, not giant isolated objects.
City: Athens. Scene: the Parthenon on its rock, whitewashed old-quarter houses stepping down with bougainvillea, olive and pine, a pine-clad hill with a small chapel, deep Aegean light. Light: warm low golden sun; coherent golden hour. Stripe and tag: Aegean blue, olive green, gold (#286580, #6d7951, #d3ad64). Keep all six pictures coherent in light, palette and landmarks.
One landscape 3:2 vintage postcard 1536 × 1024 PNG. Thin deckled warm-cream edge, faint soft shadow, centred and straight-on. Genuine transparency outside, NO opaque presentation backdrop. Same city scene recomposed with key subject in LEFT 60%; RIGHT 35% quieter, particularly upper right. No tags, postmarks, stamps or UI.
qaNotes: Symbolic Athens poster: Parthenon rock, white old-quarter houses, bougainvillea, olive/pine and chapel hill in Aegean light; no type, flags or faces. Same golden palette throughout. Light/dark final sheets inspected; all template checks pass; all three card speckle counts 0.
